title: Two entries, two years, two routes — B3.13 vs D1.1 in dairy cattle
caption: Timeline of H5N1 2.3.4.4b in U.S. dairy cattle: B3.13's sustained outbreak (Texas Feb 2024 → 13 states by July, M631L fixed) versus D1.1's later independent spillover (Wisconsin bulk milk, 2025, E627K acquired de novo). Companion to the B3.13-vs-D1.1 comparison cards.
